title: Gradient Descent on Two ReLU Neurons: Global Landscape and Bifurcation Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.42118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how gradient descent learns features remains a central challenge in neural network theory. We study this question in a minimal multi-index setting that already exhibits rich multi-phase gradient dynamics: a well-specified two-neuron ReLU teacher-student model under isotropic Gaussian inputs, trained by population gradient flow from small initialization. We show that the dynamics are organized by two directions: the "easy" bisector direction, which carries the leading signal, and the "hard" splitting direction, which governs specialization. To characterize the loss structure and learning behavior, we analyze the population squared-loss landscape and show that every critical point with both student weights nonzero is either a global minimum or a saddle. translated_title: 两个ReLU神经元上的梯度下降：全局景观与分岔动力学
translated_abstract: 理解梯度下降如何学习特征仍然是神经网络理论中的一个核心挑战。我们在一个已经展现出丰富多阶段梯度动力学的最小多指标设置中研究这个问题：一个良定义的双神经元ReLU教师-学生模型，在各向同性高斯输入下，从小初始化开始通过总体梯度流进行训练。我们证明动力学由两个方向组织：携带主要信号的“容易”平分线方向，以及控制特征专业化的“困难”分裂方向。为了刻画损失结构和学习行为，我们分析了总体平方损失景观，并证明每个学生权重都非零的临界点要么是全局最小值，要么是鞍点。随后我们追踪梯度流轨迹，表明学生神经元首先坍缩向平分线鞍点，之后才逃逸并专业化以匹配教师神经元。
tldr: 该论文证明双神经元ReLU教师-学生模型中的梯度流动力学由“容易”的平分线方向和“困难”的分裂方向共同组织，学生神经元先坍缩至平分线鞍点再逃逸并实现特征专业化，且所有非平凡临界点要么是全局最小值要么是鞍点。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that gradient flow in a two-neuron ReLU teacher-student model is organized by an "easy" bisector direction and a "hard" splitting direction, with student neurons first collapsing to a bisector saddle before escaping and specializing, and every critical point with both nonzero student weights is either a global minimum or a saddle.
